from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Imagine a seed growing into a tree.",
            "The base is our starting seed.",
            "The exponent is our growth time.",
            "The result is the final height.",
            "Two raised to three equals eight. [Asset: growth_tree_animation]"
        ]
        self.setup_layout("The Bridge: Prerequisite Recap", lecture_lines)
        
        seed = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/seed.svg")
        exponent = Text("t", color="#FFCC00")
        result = Text("8", color="#FF0000")
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(FadeOut(self.title))
        self.place_in_area(seed, 'B2', 'B4', scale_factor=1.2)
        self.play(FadeIn(seed.set_color("#00FF00")))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#00FF00")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#00FF00")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.place_at_grid(exponent, 'B5', scale_factor=1.0)
        self.play(FadeIn(exponent))
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#00FF00")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.place_at_grid(result, 'C5', scale_factor=1.0)
        self.play(Write(result))
        self.lecture[3].set_color("#00FF00")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Re-using the seed for the emphasis
        self.play(Flash(result, color="#FF0000"), Flash(seed, color="#FF0000"))
        
        tree = Square(color=WHITE) # Placeholder for [Asset: growth_tree_animation]
        self.place_in_area(tree, 'C2', 'D5', scale_factor=0.9)
        self.play(Create(tree))
        
        caption_label = Text("2^3=8", color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(caption_label, 'F2', scale_factor=0.7)
        self.play(FadeIn(caption_label))
        
        self.lecture[4].set_color("#00FF00")
        self.wait(2)

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Logarithms: Finding the Time", [
            "Logarithms tell us the time passed.", 
            "We measure how long it grew.", 
            "Log base two of eight is three."
        ])
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FFD700"))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#00FFFF"))
        
        # Variable 't'
        t_dot = Dot(color="#00FFFF")
        t_label = MathTex("t").next_to(t_dot, UP)
        t_group = VGroup(t_dot, t_label)
        self.place_at_grid(t_group, 'B3', scale_factor=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(t_group))
        
        # Flash 't'
        for _ in range(3):
            self.play(t_group.animate.set_color(WHITE), run_time=0.2)
            self.play(t_group.animate.set_color("#00FFFF"), run_time=0.2)
        
        # Fade out title and t_group, show stopwatch
        self.play(FadeOut(self.title), FadeOut(t_group))
        
        stopwatch_animation = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/stopwatch.svg")

        log_expr = MathTex(r"\\log_2(8) = 3", color="#FF69B4")

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "These are three parts of one story.",
            "Powers, roots, and logarithms unite.",
            "Base, exponent, result form a triangle.",
            "We slide the dial to transform equations.",
            "All expressions describe the same truth."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Unified Notation: The Magic Triangle", lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors for lines
        colors = [BLUE, GREEN, YELLOW, ORANGE, RED]

        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(colors[0]))
        title_magic = Text("The Magic Triangle", font_size=40, color=WHITE)
        self.place_in_area(title_magic, 'A2', 'A5', scale_factor=0.9)
        self.play(FadeIn(title_magic))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(FadeOut(title_magic))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(colors[1]))
        # Use an SVG placeholder if standard polygon was requested via 'triangle_animation' variable
        triangle_animation = Polygon(
            self.grid['B4'], self.grid['E2'], self.grid['E6'],
            color=WHITE
        )
        self.place_in_area(triangle_animation, 'B3', 'F5', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        label_a = Text("Base", font_size=24, color=WHITE).next_to(triangle_animation.get_top(), UP)
        label_b = Text("Exponent", font_size=24, color=WHITE).next_to(triangle_animation.get_left(), LEFT)
        label_c = Text("Result", font_size=24, color=WHITE).next_to(triangle_animation.get_right(), RIGHT)
        
        self.play(Create(triangle_animation), Write(label_a), Write(label_b), Write(label_c))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(colors[2]))
        self.play(triangle_animation.animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        self.wait(0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(colors[3]))
        dial = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/dial.svg")
        self.place_at_grid(dial, 'D3', scale_factor=0.7)
        self.play(FadeIn(dial))
        self.play(dial.animate.shift(RIGHT * 0.5), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(dial.animate.shift(LEFT * 0.5), run_time=0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[4].animate.set_color(colors[4]))
        self.play(Flash(triangle_animation, color=RED, num_lines=10))

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Application: The Astronaut's Fuel", [
            "Rockets use this to track fuel.",
            "We solve for time using logs.",
            "Math fuels our journey through space."
        ])
        
        # Use SVG asset for rocket

outline.topic: The Mathematical Trinity: Powers, Roots, and Logarithms

sections.title: The Bridge: Prerequisite Recap
sections.content: Briefly revisit the exponential form: base^exponent = result. Visualize this as a 'Growth Tree' where the base is the seed, the exponent is the time, and the result is the tree height.

sections.title: Roots: Finding the Seed
sections.content: Introduce radicals as the inverse operation to find the 'base'. Use a visual 'Rewind' animation where the tree shrinks back to its seed size based on the growth time.
sections.example: 3rd root of 8 = 2. If the tree grew to height 8 in 3 cycles, what was the original seed? It was 2.

sections.title: Logarithms: Finding the Time
sections.content: Define logarithms as the 'Stopwatch'. Given the seed and the final height, how long did the growth take? Highlight this as the power variable isolation technique.
sections.example: log_2(8) = 3. A rabbit population starts at 2 and reaches 8. The logarithm tells us it took 3 generations.

sections.title: Unified Notation: The Magic Triangle
sections.content: Display a graphical 'Triangle of Equivalence'. Show how base^exponent = result, root_exponent(result) = base, and log_base(result) = exponent are just three ways to tell the same story.
sections.example: 2^3 = 8; cube-root(8) = 2; log_2(8) = 3. Use an animation of a character sliding a 'transformation' dial between these three formats.

sections.title: Application: The Astronaut's Fuel
sections.content: Synthesize the knowledge. Present a scenario where a rocket’s fuel efficiency follows an exponential decay. Show how we need all three notations to calculate total fuel, rate of decay, and time until empty.
sections.example: A smart-rocket uses 10^t fuel. If the computer reports 1000 units used, we use the logarithm to see the travel time was 3 units.
